name: Inventory Microservice - Network & Upstream Fault Simulation Rules
description: Exported Requestly rules configuration for simulating latency, 429 rate limiting, and 500 upstream server failures on FastAPI inventory endpoints.

rules.name: Simulate API Rate Limiting (HTTP 429)
rules.description: Intercepts POST requests to /api/v1/inventory/update and responds with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests to test frontend throttling resilience.

rules.name: Simulate Upstream ERP Server Failure (HTTP 500)
rules.description: Intercepts inventory update calls to simulate an internal upstream warehouse synchronization crash.

rules.name: Simulate 2500ms Network Latency Delay
rules.description: Injects artificial 2.5 second network delay to test frontend loading spinners and timeout handling.
